title: OpenreKeyRotateRequest
description: openre.key-rotate-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/streams/:id/keys/rotate on OpenRe.Stream (openre.key.rotate). grace_seconds (0 by default, at most 7 days) keeps the old key working that long; end_sessions true also ends the stream's open sessions. An empty body rotates with no grace.
